mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRX_EVENT_OUTBOX (ID, EVENT_TYPE, AGGREGATE_ID, PAYLOAD, STATUS, ATTEMPTS, CREATED_DT) VALUES (#{id}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, N'NEW', 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT o.ID AS "id", o.EVENT_TYPE AS "eventType", o.AGGREGATE_ID AS "aggregateId", o.PAYLOAD AS "payload", o.ATTEMPTS AS "attempts" FROM TRX_EVENT_OUTBOX o WHERE o.ID IN ( SELECT ID FROM (SELECT ID FROM TRX_EVENT_OUTBOX WHERE STATUS = N'NEW' ORDER BY CREATED_DT) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}) ORDER BY o.CREATED_DT FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE TRX_EVENT_OUTBOX SET STATUS = N'SENT', ATTEMPTS = ATTEMPTS + 1, LAST_ERROR = NULL, SENT_DT = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
